goal: Prevent light clients from disconnecting or banning nodes when requesting new block compact filters
Answer BIP 157 filter requests once built instead of dropping racing messages on newly connected blocks
agreement: Substantive support with all prior objections resolved (ajtowns, mzumsande)
Worth handling because slow filter creation causes regular races with light clients (ajtowns)
Supports handling racing requests in message processing to avoid peer disconnects (mzumsande)
Earlier objections on index coupling and message coverage were resolved (sedited, mzumsande, ajtowns)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents light clients from dropping or banning nodes due to slow filter generation
Occasional race windows currently break interoperability with BIP 157 light clients on new blocks
